# Vibe Design — agent reference index

Study version: 2026.09 · Delivery schema: 1

Read the user's project brief and existing DESIGN.md before using a style. Default to preserving the current project's business logic, brand, assets and component contracts. Principles and authored example tokens are distinct; exact demo hashes are included in each file. Browser and behavior acceptance remains necessary after implementation.

先读项目简报与已有 DESIGN.md，默认保留业务、品牌、素材和组件契约。风格原则与示例 Tokens 分开记录，实施后仍需浏览器及功能验收。

# Apple Minimalism / Apple 风

- Type / 类型：Design language / 设计语言
- Tags / 标签：Minimal · Modern / 极简 · 现代
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：3 Hard; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：SaaS / Tech / SaaS / 科技产品, Enterprise / B2B / 企业 / B2B
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/apple)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/apple.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/apple/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Center the product: short headlines, large product imagery, clear benefits and restrained sections.

以产品为中心：短标题、大幅产品画面、清楚的卖点与克制的分区。

System sans-serif, tight display tracking and consistent spacing; reserve blue for links and primary actions. Let material and whitespace establish hierarchy.

系统无衬线字体，紧凑标题字距，统一间距；蓝色用于链接和主操作，材质与留白共同建立层级。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original product-page study, not an official Apple template. The demo brand and specifications are fictional.

原创产品网页演绎，不是 Apple 官方模板；演示中的品牌与规格为虚构内容。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

- [Apple · Human Interface Guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/)

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #ffffff;
  --bg-alt: #f5f5f7;
  --fg: #1d1d1f;
  --fg-soft: #6e6e73;
  --accent: #0071e3;
  --accent-hover: #0077ed;
  --dark: #000000;
  --hairline: rgba(0,0,0,.08);
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Apple Minimalism. Center the product: short headlines, large product imagery, clear benefits and restrained sections. System sans-serif, tight display tracking and consistent spacing; reserve blue for links and primary actions. Let material and whitespace establish hierarchy. Whitespace must support content. Oversized corners, no accent color or a single shadow size are not universal rules. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

Apple 风。以产品为中心：短标题、大幅产品画面、清楚的卖点与克制的分区。系统无衬线字体，紧凑标题字距，统一间距；蓝色用于链接和主操作，材质与留白共同建立层级。不要把大留白变成内容缺失，也不要把大圆角、无强调色或某个阴影尺寸当作通用规则。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Product imagery and short headlines establish a clear focus
  - 中文：产品画面与短标题形成明确焦点
- A consistent type and spacing scale can be reused across pages
  - 中文：统一字阶与间距便于跨页面复用
- Restrained accents leave room for the primary action
  - 中文：克制的强调色为主操作保留位置
- Section spacing separates the product story from supporting detail
  - 中文：分区留白可区分产品信息与细节

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Generous whitespace needs purposeful copy and imagery
  - 中文：大留白需要足够的内容与图像支撑
- Complex data needs a structure beyond a sparse layout
  - 中文：低密度布局需为复杂数据另设结构
- Type weight, image sizing and responsive crops need individual tuning
  - 中文：细字重、图像尺寸与响应式裁切需要逐项调整

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Whitespace must support content. Oversized corners, no accent color or a single shadow size are not universal rules.
  - 中文：不要把大留白变成内容缺失，也不要把大圆角、无强调色或某个阴影尺寸当作通用规则。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Apple.com · Linear.app · Notion.so · Stripe.com · Vercel.com

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

Reference file: apple.html (349 source lines). Source and outputs can change together; retain the version and hash when recording an implementation decision.

# DESIGN.md — Apple Minimalism / Apple 风

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Center the product: short headlines, large product imagery, clear benefits and restrained sections.

以产品为中心：短标题、大幅产品画面、清楚的卖点与克制的分区。

System sans-serif, tight display tracking and consistent spacing; reserve blue for links and primary actions. Let material and whitespace establish hierarchy.

系统无衬线字体，紧凑标题字距，统一间距；蓝色用于链接和主操作，材质与留白共同建立层级。

Avoid / 避免：Whitespace must support content. Oversized corners, no accent color or a single shadow size are not universal rules. 不要把大留白变成内容缺失，也不要把大圆角、无强调色或某个阴影尺寸当作通用规则。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #ffffff;
  --bg-alt: #f5f5f7;
  --fg: #1d1d1f;
  --fg-soft: #6e6e73;
  --accent: #0071e3;
  --accent-hover: #0077ed;
  --dark: #000000;
  --hairline: rgba(0,0,0,.08);
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Braun / Dieter Rams / 迪特·拉姆斯风

- Type / 类型：Design language / 设计语言
- Tags / 标签：Minimal · Classic / 极简 · 经典
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：2 Medium; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Creative / Design / 创意 / 设计, Enterprise / B2B / 企业 / B2B
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/braun)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/braun.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/braun/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Use a modular grid and functional grouping. Align labels, scales and controls.

用模数网格组织信息，按真实功能分组；标签、刻度和控件相互对齐。

Neutral grays, clear labeling and restrained functional color; tactile material details serve use.

中性灰、清楚的标识与克制的功能色；触感来自材质细节，装饰服从使用。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --u: 8px;
  --bg: #f2f2f2;
  --panel: #ffffff;
  --ink: #1a1a1a;
  --gray: #808080;
  --line: #c9c9c9;
  --metal-hi: #f6f6f6;
  --metal-lo: #dcdcdc;
  --accent: #e8500a;
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Braun / Dieter Rams. Use a modular grid and functional grouping. Align labels, scales and controls. Neutral grays, clear labeling and restrained functional color; tactile material details serve use. Avoid orange everywhere or decorative controls without a purpose. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

迪特·拉姆斯风。用模数网格组织信息，按真实功能分组；标签、刻度和控件相互对齐。中性灰、清楚的标识与克制的功能色；触感来自材质细节，装饰服从使用。不要给所有元素加橙色或无功能的仪表盘装饰。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- A modular grid groups related functions
  - 中文：模数网格把相关功能组织在一起
- Labels, scales and controls share alignment axes
  - 中文：标签、刻度与控件共享对齐轴
- Functional colors have distinct roles against neutral surfaces
  - 中文：功能色与中性底色有清楚分工
- Repeated control dimensions support component conventions
  - 中文：重复的控件规格便于形成组件约定

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Labels, numbers and controls need careful proportional work
  - 中文：需要仔细处理标签、数字与控件的比例
- Brand storytelling needs support from copy and imagery
  - 中文：品牌故事需要另用内容和图像表达
- Removing too many boundaries can obscure interactive controls
  - 中文：过度删减边界可能让操作不易辨认

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Avoid orange everywhere or decorative controls without a purpose.
  - 中文：不要给所有元素加橙色或无功能的仪表盘装饰。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Braun.com · Vitsoe.com · Teenage Engineering · Leica · Bang & Olufsen

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

Reference file: braun.html (403 source lines). Source and outputs can change together; retain the version and hash when recording an implementation decision.

# DESIGN.md — Braun / Dieter Rams / 迪特·拉姆斯风

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Use a modular grid and functional grouping. Align labels, scales and controls.

用模数网格组织信息，按真实功能分组；标签、刻度和控件相互对齐。

Neutral grays, clear labeling and restrained functional color; tactile material details serve use.

中性灰、清楚的标识与克制的功能色；触感来自材质细节，装饰服从使用。

Avoid / 避免：Avoid orange everywhere or decorative controls without a purpose. 不要给所有元素加橙色或无功能的仪表盘装饰。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --u: 8px;
  --bg: #f2f2f2;
  --panel: #ffffff;
  --ink: #1a1a1a;
  --gray: #808080;
  --line: #c9c9c9;
  --metal-hi: #f6f6f6;
  --metal-lo: #dcdcdc;
  --accent: #e8500a;
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Flat Design / 扁平化

- Type / 类型：Design language / 设计语言
- Tags / 标签：Minimal · Modern · Classic / 极简 · 现代 · 经典
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：1 Easy; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Enterprise / B2B / 企业 / B2B
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/flat)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/flat.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/flat/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Organize tasks with solid color regions, clear typography and simple icons.

用纯色分区、明确字号和简单图标组织任务。

Solid fills, clear boundaries and consistent icon strokes; hierarchy comes from contrast and position.

平面色块、清晰边界与一致的图标笔画，靠对比和位置形成层级。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --blue: #2196F3;
  --blue-dark: #1976D2;
  --blue-tint: #E3F2FD;
  --green: #4CAF50;
  --green-dark: #388E3C;
  --orange: #FF9800;
  --orange-dark: #EF6C00;
  --orange-tint: #FFF3E0;
  --purple: #9C27B0;
  --purple-dark: #7B1FA2;
  --purple-tint: #F3E5F5;
  --cyan: #00BCD4;
  --cyan-tint: #E0F7FA;
  --ink: #263238;
  --muted: #607D8B;
  --bg: #FFFFFF;
  --bg-soft: #ECEFF1;
  --line: #CFD8DC;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Flat Design. Organize tasks with solid color regions, clear typography and simple icons. Solid fills, clear boundaries and consistent icon strokes; hierarchy comes from contrast and position. Avoid bevels, material reflections and decorative gradients; preserve interaction states. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

扁平化。用纯色分区、明确字号和简单图标组织任务。平面色块、清晰边界与一致的图标笔画，靠对比和位置形成层级。避免立体斜面、材质反光和装饰性渐变；保留操作状态。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Solid regions and simple icons keep surfaces clear
  - 中文：纯色分区与简单图标保持表面清楚
- Hierarchy can be established without material reflections
  - 中文：不依赖材质反光也能建立层级
- Color and type rules can be mapped across platforms
  - 中文：颜色与字号规则可映射到不同平台
- Buttons and forms can share a consistent state language
  - 中文：按钮与表单能使用一致的状态语言

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Boundaries, labels and position must signal interactions
  - 中文：需要用边界、标签和位置补足操作提示
- Color blocks alone can flatten content hierarchy
  - 中文：只用色块可能让不同内容层级相似
- Brand identity needs type, imagery or distinctive graphics
  - 中文：品牌辨识需要依靠字体、图像或专属图形

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Avoid bevels, material reflections and decorative gradients; preserve interaction states.
  - 中文：避免立体斜面、材质反光和装饰性渐变；保留操作状态。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Windows 8/10 UI · Early iOS 7-12 · Google Material Design · Spotify

# DESIGN.md — Flat Design / 扁平化

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Organize tasks with solid color regions, clear typography and simple icons.

用纯色分区、明确字号和简单图标组织任务。

Solid fills, clear boundaries and consistent icon strokes; hierarchy comes from contrast and position.

平面色块、清晰边界与一致的图标笔画，靠对比和位置形成层级。

Avoid / 避免：Avoid bevels, material reflections and decorative gradients; preserve interaction states. 避免立体斜面、材质反光和装饰性渐变；保留操作状态。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --blue: #2196F3;
  --blue-dark: #1976D2;
  --blue-tint: #E3F2FD;
  --green: #4CAF50;
  --green-dark: #388E3C;
  --orange: #FF9800;
  --orange-dark: #EF6C00;
  --orange-tint: #FFF3E0;
  --purple: #9C27B0;
  --purple-dark: #7B1FA2;
  --purple-tint: #F3E5F5;
  --cyan: #00BCD4;
  --cyan-tint: #E0F7FA;
  --ink: #263238;
  --muted: #607D8B;
  --bg: #FFFFFF;
  --bg-soft: #ECEFF1;
  --line: #CFD8DC;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

Reference HTML: https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/flat.html

# Material Design / Material Design

- Type / 类型：Design language / 设计语言
- Tags / 标签：Modern · Classic / 现代 · 经典
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：2 Medium; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Enterprise / B2B / 企业 / B2B
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/material)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/material.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/material/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Organize UI around Material 3 color roles, type scale, shape and state.

按 Material 3 的色彩角色、字号层级、形状与状态组织界面。

This study uses a purple primary, tonal surfaces and Roboto; its 56px FAB has 16px corners with clear hover and pressed feedback.

本例采用紫色主色、调性表面与 Roboto；56px FAB 使用 16px 圆角，悬浮与按下状态有明确反馈。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

A Material 3 web study. Task interactions are local to this page, without services or saved data.

Material 3 网页演绎；任务交互只在当前页面生效，不连接服务或保存数据。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

- [Material 3 · Theme, type & shape](https://developer.android.com/codelabs/m3-design-theming?hl=en)
- [Material 3 · Floating action button](https://developer.android.com/develop/ui/compose/components/fab)

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --primary: #6750A4;
  --on-primary: #FFFFFF;
  --primary-container: #EADDFF;
  --on-primary-container: #21005D;
  --secondary-container: #E8DEF8;
  --on-secondary-container: #1D192B;
  --tertiary-container: #FFD8E4;
  --on-tertiary-container: #31111D;
  --surface: #FEF7FF;
  --surface-dim: #F8F1FA;
  --surface-c-low: #F7F2FA;
  --surface-c: #F3EDF7;
  --surface-c-high: #ECE6F0;
  --on-surface: #1C1B1F;
  --on-surface-var: #49454F;
  --outline: #79747E;
  --outline-var: #CAC4D0;
  --blue: #4285F4;
  --green: #34A853;
  --yellow: #FBBC05;
  --red: #EA4335;
  --grey: #5F6368;
  --e1: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 1px 3px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  --e2: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 2px 6px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  --e3: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 4px 8px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  --e4: 0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 6px 10px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
  --sans: "Roboto",-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Material Design. Organize UI around Material 3 color roles, type scale, shape and state. This study uses a purple primary, tonal surfaces and Roboto; its 56px FAB has 16px corners with clear hover and pressed feedback. Google brand colors are not a required Material palette, and circular FABs are not a rule for every version. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

Material Design。按 Material 3 的色彩角色、字号层级、形状与状态组织界面。本例采用紫色主色、调性表面与 Roboto；56px FAB 使用 16px 圆角，悬浮与按下状态有明确反馈。不要把 Google 品牌四色当成 Material 的必选配色，或把圆形 FAB 当作所有版本的规范。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Color roles, type scales and shapes have coordinated naming
  - 中文：色彩角色、字阶与形状有成套命名
- Selected, hover and pressed states can share one system
  - 中文：选中、悬浮与按下状态可按同一体系组织
- Component patterns address common navigation and form tasks
  - 中文：组件模式覆盖常见导航与表单任务
- Tonal surfaces can distinguish information layers
  - 中文：调性色表面能区分信息层次

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- The chosen version and component implementation must be explicit
  - 中文：需要明确采用的版本和组件实现
- Default components need adaptation to carry the brand
  - 中文：默认组件需要调整以承接品牌表达
- Motion and elevation cannot replace task feedback
  - 中文：动效和层级不能直接替代任务反馈

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Google brand colors are not a required Material palette, and circular FABs are not a rule for every version.
  - 中文：不要把 Google 品牌四色当成 Material 的必选配色，或把圆形 FAB 当作所有版本的规范。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

All Google products · Android system UI · Flutter apps · YouTube

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Swiss Style / International Typographic / 瑞士风格

- Type / 类型：Design movement / 设计流派
- Tags / 标签：Minimal · Classic / 极简 · 经典
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：2 Medium; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：E-commerce / Retail / 电商 / 零售, Creative / Design / 创意 / 设计, Enterprise / B2B / 企业 / B2B
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/swiss)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/swiss.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/swiss/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Build an asymmetric grid with shared axes for headlines, rules, numbers and body copy.

建立非对称网格，标题、栏线、编号和正文共享对齐轴。

Use neo-grotesque type weight, spacing and scale to establish order; red carries emphasis in this study.

用新怪诞体的字重、字距和比例建立秩序；红色在本例中承担信息强调。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

- [MoMA · Josef Müller-Brockmann](https://www.moma.org/artists/4154-josef-muller-brockmann)

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #FFFFFF;
  --fg: #000000;
  --accent: #FF0000;
  --gold: #FFD700;
  --blue: #0000FF;
  --hair: #000000;
  --sans: "Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Swiss Style / International Typographic. Build an asymmetric grid with shared axes for headlines, rules, numbers and body copy. Use neo-grotesque type weight, spacing and scale to establish order; red carries emphasis in this study. A large headline alone is insufficient. Column measure, baselines and whitespace matter; primary colors are optional. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

瑞士风格。建立非对称网格，标题、栏线、编号和正文共享对齐轴。用新怪诞体的字重、字距和比例建立秩序；红色在本例中承担信息强调。不要只放一个超大标题；正文栏宽、基线和留白同样重要，红黄蓝并非强制色盘。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Grids, rules and numbering establish reading order together
  - 中文：网格、栏线与编号共同建立阅读顺序
- Type weight and scale carry the main visual expression
  - 中文：字重与比例承担主要的视觉表达
- Asymmetric structure can accommodate several information levels
  - 中文：非对称结构可以容纳多层信息
- Accent color can be concentrated on key information
  - 中文：强调色可集中用于关键信息

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Chinese type, spacing and Latin proportions need separate tuning
  - 中文：中文字体、字距与英文比例需要分别调整
- Long headlines and changing copy affect grid balance
  - 中文：长标题与内容变化会影响网格平衡
- Commercial fonts require license checks; suitable open fonts are an alternative
  - 中文：商业字体需要核实授权，也可采用合适的开放字体

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- A large headline alone is insufficient. Column measure, baselines and whitespace matter; primary colors are optional.
  - 中文：不要只放一个超大标题；正文栏宽、基线和留白同样重要，红黄蓝并非强制色盘。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Josef Müller-Brockmann works · Emil Ruder works · Neue Haas Grotesk site · Type Directors Club

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Swiss Style / International Typographic / 瑞士风格

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Build an asymmetric grid with shared axes for headlines, rules, numbers and body copy.

建立非对称网格，标题、栏线、编号和正文共享对齐轴。

Use neo-grotesque type weight, spacing and scale to establish order; red carries emphasis in this study.

用新怪诞体的字重、字距和比例建立秩序；红色在本例中承担信息强调。

Avoid / 避免：A large headline alone is insufficient. Column measure, baselines and whitespace matter; primary colors are optional. 不要只放一个超大标题；正文栏宽、基线和留白同样重要，红黄蓝并非强制色盘。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #FFFFFF;
  --fg: #000000;
  --accent: #FF0000;
  --gold: #FFD700;
  --blue: #0000FF;
  --hair: #000000;
  --sans: "Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Bento Grid / Bento 网格

- Type / 类型：Layout pattern / 布局模式
- Tags / 标签：Minimal · Modern / 极简 · 现代
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：2 Medium; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：SaaS / Tech / SaaS / 科技产品, E-commerce / Retail / 电商 / 零售
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/bento)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/bento.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/bento/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Arrange different amounts of information in a hierarchical modular grid; spanning cells carry the main story.

把不同体量的信息放入有主次的模块网格，跨列卡片承担重点内容。

This study uses 24px desktop card corners, white-gray surfaces and selective blue-violet accents, reordered for mobile.

本例桌面卡片采用 24px 圆角、白灰表面和少量蓝紫强调，手机按内容顺序重排。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #F0F0F0;
  --card: #FFFFFF;
  --dark: #1E1E1E;
  --ink: #000000;
  --ink-soft: #515154;
  --on-dark: #F5F5F7;
  --on-dark-soft: #A1A1A6;
  --accent: #007AFF;
  --violet: #7D4CFF;
  --edge: rgba(0,0,0,.07);
  --edge-dark: rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --radius: 24px;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Bento Grid. Arrange different amounts of information in a hierarchical modular grid; spanning cells carry the main story. This study uses 24px desktop card corners, white-gray surfaces and selective blue-violet accents, reordered for mobile. Bento is a composable layout, not a fixed palette. Avoid giving every tile equal visual weight. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

Bento 网格。把不同体量的信息放入有主次的模块网格，跨列卡片承担重点内容。本例桌面卡片采用 24px 圆角、白灰表面和少量蓝紫强调，手机按内容顺序重排。不要把它理解成固定配色的独立风格；它可以与设计语言组合，避免每张卡片同等抢眼。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Spanning modules can emphasize priority content
  - 中文：跨列模块可以突出重点内容
- Different tile sizes can reflect different amounts of information
  - 中文：不同大小的卡片对应不同信息量
- Images, data and short copy can share a modular grid
  - 中文：图片、数据与简短说明可共享模块网格
- The layout can combine with brand type, color and material rules
  - 中文：可与品牌字体、色彩和材质规则组合

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Each module needs an information priority before layout
  - 中文：需要先确定每个模块的信息优先级
- Mobile needs its own content-order and spanning checks
  - 中文：手机端必须重新检查内容顺序和跨列规则
- Fixed tile heights can clip long Chinese copy and dynamic content
  - 中文：固定卡片高度可能截断长中文和动态内容

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Bento is a composable layout, not a fixed palette. Avoid giving every tile equal visual weight.
  - 中文：不要把它理解成固定配色的独立风格；它可以与设计语言组合，避免每张卡片同等抢眼。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Apple Product Pages · Linear Features · Notion.so · Raycast · Arc Browser

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Bento Grid / Bento 网格

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Arrange different amounts of information in a hierarchical modular grid; spanning cells carry the main story.

把不同体量的信息放入有主次的模块网格，跨列卡片承担重点内容。

This study uses 24px desktop card corners, white-gray surfaces and selective blue-violet accents, reordered for mobile.

本例桌面卡片采用 24px 圆角、白灰表面和少量蓝紫强调，手机按内容顺序重排。

Avoid / 避免：Bento is a composable layout, not a fixed palette. Avoid giving every tile equal visual weight. 不要把它理解成固定配色的独立风格；它可以与设计语言组合，避免每张卡片同等抢眼。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #F0F0F0;
  --card: #FFFFFF;
  --dark: #1E1E1E;
  --ink: #000000;
  --ink-soft: #515154;
  --on-dark: #F5F5F7;
  --on-dark-soft: #A1A1A6;
  --accent: #007AFF;
  --violet: #7D4CFF;
  --edge: rgba(0,0,0,.07);
  --edge-dark: rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --radius: 24px;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Aurora Gradients / 极光渐变

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Modern / 现代
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：3 Hard; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：SaaS / Tech / SaaS / 科技产品
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/aurora)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/aurora.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/aurora/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Use broad soft gradients as atmosphere while keeping copy and product areas stable.

用大范围柔和渐变组织背景，保留稳定的文字和产品展示区域。

Blend warm and cool bands smoothly; control blur and luminance and carry accent color into select actions.

让冷暖色带平滑交汇，控制模糊半径与亮度，强调色延续到少量操作。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #FAFAFC;
  --surface: #FFFFFF;
  --ink: #0A0A14;
  --ink-soft: #55556B;
  --ink-faint: #8B8BA3;
  --edge: #E6E6EE;
  --edge-soft: #F0F0F6;
  --aurora-iris: #635BFF;
  --aurora-indigo: #7A73FF;
  --aurora-cyan: #00D4FF;
  --aurora-pink: #FF80BF;
  --gradient-aurora: linear-gradient(95deg,var(--aurora-iris) 0%,var(--aurora-cyan) 52%,var(--aurora-pink) 104%);
  --dark: #0A0A14;
  --dark-raised: #111126;
  --on-dark: #F1F1FA;
  --on-dark-soft: #9C9CBC;
  --ok: #16B87A;
  --syntax-comment: #5E5E84;
  --syntax-keyword: #FF88C6;
  --syntax-string: #74E4FF;
  --syntax-ident: #BDB9FF;
  --syntax-plain: #E9E9F6;
  --radius-lg: 20px;
  --radius-md: 12px;
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue",Roboto,Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,"Courier New",monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Aurora Gradients. Use broad soft gradients as atmosphere while keeping copy and product areas stable. Blend warm and cool bands smoothly; control blur and luminance and carry accent color into select actions. Do not turn every card into a gradient; keep a stable contrast behind text. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

极光渐变。用大范围柔和渐变组织背景，保留稳定的文字和产品展示区域。让冷暖色带平滑交汇，控制模糊半径与亮度，强调色延续到少量操作。不要把所有卡片都变成渐变；文字背景需要稳定对比。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Broad gradients can provide an atmospheric content layer
  - 中文：大范围渐变可为内容提供氛围层
- Color bands can be derived from existing brand colors
  - 中文：色带可以从既有品牌色延伸
- Gradients and blur can be expressed in CSS
  - 中文：渐变与模糊可用 CSS 表达
- Stable foreground surfaces can hold the product and primary action
  - 中文：稳定的前景表面可承接产品和主操作

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Similar gradients need typography to distinguish the brand
  - 中文：相近的渐变需要配合排版才能区分品牌
- Text contrast needs checking as the background changes
  - 中文：文字背景变化时需要逐处检查对比
- Large blurred or animated regions need rendering checks on target devices
  - 中文：大面积模糊或动画需在目标设备上检查渲染

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Do not turn every card into a gradient; keep a stable contrast behind text.
  - 中文：不要把所有卡片都变成渐变；文字背景需要稳定对比。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Stripe.com · Linear.app · Raycast.com · Resend.com · Clerk.com

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

```css
  --radius-lg: 20px;
  --radius-md: 12px;
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue",Roboto,Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,"Courier New",monospace;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

Reference HTML: https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/aurora.html
