# Bauhaus / 包豪斯

- Type / 类型：Design movement / 设计流派
- Tags / 标签：Art · Vintage · Classic / 艺术 · 复古 · 经典
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：2 Medium; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Creative / Design / 创意 / 设计
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/bauhaus)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/bauhaus.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/bauhaus/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Let geometry, typography and space form an asymmetric structure together.

让几何形状、字体和空间共同构成非对称结构。

Cream, red-yellow-blue and geometric construction express experimentation in this study; color and form have clear relationships.

本例用米白、红黄蓝和几何构成传达实验感；色彩和形状之间有明确关系。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --red: #E2261C;
  --yellow: #F2BE0F;
  --blue: #1F3BB3;
  --black: #131313;
  --paper: #F4F1EA;
  --white: #FFFFFF;
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Bauhaus. Let geometry, typography and space form an asymmetric structure together. Cream, red-yellow-blue and geometric construction express experimentation in this study; color and form have clear relationships. Thick black outlines and primary colors are not mandatory across all historical Bauhaus work. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

包豪斯。让几何形状、字体和空间共同构成非对称结构。本例用米白、红黄蓝和几何构成传达实验感；色彩和形状之间有明确关系。不要把粗黑描边或三个原色当成全部历史作品的统一规范。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Geometric forms participate directly in composition
  - 中文：几何形状直接参与版面结构
- Proportions between type and form can establish rhythm
  - 中文：字体与形状的比例可以形成节奏
- A limited palette supports distinct color roles
  - 中文：有限色盘便于建立色彩角色
- Repetition and variation can form a graphic language across pages
  - 中文：重复和变化可形成跨页面的图形语言

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Geometric ornament needs a relationship with real content
  - 中文：形状装饰需要与实际内容保持关系
- Vivid primaries need controlled proportions and text contrast
  - 中文：鲜明原色需要控制比例与文字对比
- Complex forms and data views need restrained ornament density
  - 中文：复杂表单和数据页需要收敛装饰密度

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Thick black outlines and primary colors are not mandatory across all historical Bauhaus work.
  - 中文：不要把粗黑描边或三个原色当成全部历史作品的统一规范。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Bauhaus-Archiv Berlin · Vitra Design Museum · MoMA Design Store · Alessi

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Bauhaus / 包豪斯

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Let geometry, typography and space form an asymmetric structure together.

让几何形状、字体和空间共同构成非对称结构。

Cream, red-yellow-blue and geometric construction express experimentation in this study; color and form have clear relationships.

本例用米白、红黄蓝和几何构成传达实验感；色彩和形状之间有明确关系。

Avoid / 避免：Thick black outlines and primary colors are not mandatory across all historical Bauhaus work. 不要把粗黑描边或三个原色当成全部历史作品的统一规范。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --red: #E2261C;
  --yellow: #F2BE0F;
  --blue: #1F3BB3;
  --black: #131313;
  --paper: #F4F1EA;
  --white: #FFFFFF;
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

# Scandinavian / 斯堪的纳维亚

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Minimal · Warm / 极简 · 温暖
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：1 Easy; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：E-commerce / Retail / 电商 / 零售
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/scandinavian)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/scandinavian.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/scandinavian/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Center everyday settings and natural materials, with clear product information and generous space.

以生活场景和自然材质为中心，清晰的商品信息搭配舒展留白。

Warm white, wood and sage, soft lighting and textile detail, with modern warm typography.

暖白、木色与鼠尾草绿，轻柔光照和织物细节；字体现代而温暖。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --cream: #f6f3ed;
  --card: #ffffff;
  --linen: #e8dcc4;
  --wood: #d4c4b7;
  --wood-deep: #b3987d;
  --sage: #8b9a7c;
  --sage-soft: #a9b5a3;
  --ink: #3e3a33;
  --ink-soft: #7d766a;
  --glow: rgba(255,222,160,.55);
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --serif: Georgia,"Palatino Linotype","Songti SC",serif;
  --r: 28px;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Scandinavian. Center everyday settings and natural materials, with clear product information and generous space. Warm white, wood and sage, soft lighting and textile detail, with modern warm typography. Go beyond beige cards; wood, textiles, proportions and lived-in context matter more than a fixed radius. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

斯堪的纳维亚。以生活场景和自然材质为中心，清晰的商品信息搭配舒展留白。暖白、木色与鼠尾草绿，轻柔光照和织物细节；字体现代而温暖。不要只剩米色卡片；木纹、织物、物体比例和生活感比固定圆角重要。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Warm whites and natural materials can share a gentle foundation
  - 中文：暖白与自然材质可以共享柔和底色
- Everyday imagery can explain how a product is used
  - 中文：生活场景图能解释商品的实际使用方式
- Whitespace leaves room for product details and explanations
  - 中文：留白为商品细节和说明保留空间
- Wood, textiles and plants can create material layers
  - 中文：木色、织物与绿植可形成材质层次

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Beige cards alone may not distinguish content
  - 中文：只用米色卡片可能缺少内容区分
- Muted colors still need distinct action contrast
  - 中文：低饱和配色需要保留明确的操作对比
- Natural imagery needs consistent lighting, proportions and licensed sources
  - 中文：自然素材需要一致的光线、比例与来源授权

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Go beyond beige cards; wood, textiles, proportions and lived-in context matter more than a fixed radius.
  - 中文：不要只剩米色卡片；木纹、织物、物体比例和生活感比固定圆角重要。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

IKEA · HAY · Muuto · Arket · COS

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Scandinavian / 斯堪的纳维亚

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Center everyday settings and natural materials, with clear product information and generous space.

以生活场景和自然材质为中心，清晰的商品信息搭配舒展留白。

Warm white, wood and sage, soft lighting and textile detail, with modern warm typography.

暖白、木色与鼠尾草绿，轻柔光照和织物细节；字体现代而温暖。

Avoid / 避免：Go beyond beige cards; wood, textiles, proportions and lived-in context matter more than a fixed radius. 不要只剩米色卡片；木纹、织物、物体比例和生活感比固定圆角重要。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --cream: #f6f3ed;
  --card: #ffffff;
  --linen: #e8dcc4;
  --wood: #d4c4b7;
  --wood-deep: #b3987d;
  --sage: #8b9a7c;
  --sage-soft: #a9b5a3;
  --ink: #3e3a33;
  --ink-soft: #7d766a;
  --glow: rgba(255,222,160,.55);
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --serif: Georgia,"Palatino Linotype","Songti SC",serif;
  --r: 28px;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Neo-Brutalism / 新粗野主义

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Avant-garde / 前卫
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：1 Easy; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Creative / Design / 创意 / 设计, Personal / Blog / 个人 / 博客
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/neo-brutalism)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/neo-brutalism.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/neo-brutalism/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Organize content with clear regions, heavy borders and emphatic hierarchy.

用清晰的信息分区、粗边框和强烈层级组织内容。

This study uses black hard-edged shadows, bold color blocks and heavy headings; shadows contract on press.

本例用黑色硬边阴影、鲜明色块和粗体标题，按下时阴影收缩。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --paper: #FFF6EA;
  --ink: #000000;
  --white: #FFFFFF;
  --orange: #FF6B35;
  --blue: #004E89;
  --yellow: #F7C548;
  --pink: #FF8FD4;
  --green: #3ECF8E;
  --bw: 4px;
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Neo-Brutalism. Organize content with clear regions, heavy borders and emphatic hierarchy. This study uses black hard-edged shadows, bold color blocks and heavy headings; shadows contract on press. Avoid blurring hard shadows or letting ornament obscure text and targets. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

新粗野主义。用清晰的信息分区、粗边框和强烈层级组织内容。本例用黑色硬边阴影、鲜明色块和粗体标题，按下时阴影收缩。避免给硬阴影加模糊，也不要让强装饰压过文字与点击目标。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Heavy borders clearly separate content and controls
  - 中文：粗边框能明确划分内容与控件
- Hard shadows and pressed offsets create visible state changes
  - 中文：硬阴影与按下位移形成可见的状态变化
- Color blocks and heavy headings provide emphatic hierarchy
  - 中文：色块与粗体标题提供鲜明层级
- Borders, offsets and shadows can share CSS variables
  - 中文：边框、偏移与阴影可用 CSS 变量统一

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Dense borders and shadows can crowd the content
  - 中文：边框与阴影过密会挤压内容空间
- Strong colors require individual text and state contrast checks
  - 中文：强烈配色需要逐一检查文字与状态对比
- Tables and complex forms need reduced ornament density
  - 中文：迁移到表格和复杂表单时需降低装饰密度

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Avoid blurring hard shadows or letting ornament obscure text and targets.
  - 中文：避免给硬阴影加模糊，也不要让强装饰压过文字与点击目标。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Figma Community · Gumroad · Poolside.fm · Pitch.com · Notion templates

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

Reference file: neo-brutalism.html (414 source lines). Source and outputs can change together; retain the version and hash when recording an implementation decision.

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css

  --ink: #000000;
  --white: #FFFFFF;

  --green: #3ECF8E;
  --bw: 4px;
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Duotone / 双色调

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Art · Vintage / 艺术 · 复古
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：1 Easy; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Personal / Blog / 个人 / 博客
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/duotone)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/duotone.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/duotone/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Carry two tonal families through type, regions and images, controlling the mapping between shadows and highlights.

让两组色调贯穿文字、分区与图像，控制明暗的对应关系。

This study maps shadows to deep navy and highlights to orange, including image treatment.

本例的暗部是深藏青、亮部是橙色；图像要呈现相同的色调映射。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --navy: #1A1A2E;
  --navy-dark: #10101F;
  --navy-light: #2A2A4A;
  --orange: #FF6B35;
  --orange-light: #FF8F66;
  --orange-pale: #FFE1D2;
  --orange-dark: #C9481A;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Duotone. Carry two tonal families through type, regions and images, controlling the mapping between shadows and highlights. This study maps shadows to deep navy and highlights to orange, including image treatment. Two background blocks alone do not demonstrate the treatment; tonal ranges need not be only two discrete values. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

双色调。让两组色调贯穿文字、分区与图像，控制明暗的对应关系。本例的暗部是深藏青、亮部是橙色；图像要呈现相同的色调映射。不要把两块背景色当成完整示范，也不要要求整个页面只能有两个离散色值。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- A shared tonal mapping can connect different images
  - 中文：统一色调映射可串联不同图像
- Two tonal families establish clear image and type relationships
  - 中文：明暗两组色调形成明确的图文关系
- The treatment can use CSS or preprocessed imagery
  - 中文：可用 CSS 或预处理图像实现
- Tonal rules can extend to posters and page regions
  - 中文：色调规则可延伸到海报与页面分区

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Each source image needs a tonal-range check
  - 中文：不同原图需要分别检查明暗层次
- A brand color pair may lose image detail
  - 中文：品牌色组合可能无法保留图像细节
- Body copy and states should not be forced into two discrete colors
  - 中文：正文与状态不应被迫压缩到两种色值

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Two background blocks alone do not demonstrate the treatment; tonal ranges need not be only two discrete values.
  - 中文：不要把两块背景色当成完整示范，也不要要求整个页面只能有两个离散色值。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Spotify Wrapped · Adidas Originals · NPR · Twitch branding · Nike ACG

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Duotone / 双色调

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Carry two tonal families through type, regions and images, controlling the mapping between shadows and highlights.

让两组色调贯穿文字、分区与图像，控制明暗的对应关系。

This study maps shadows to deep navy and highlights to orange, including image treatment.

本例的暗部是深藏青、亮部是橙色；图像要呈现相同的色调映射。

Avoid / 避免：Two background blocks alone do not demonstrate the treatment; tonal ranges need not be only two discrete values. 不要把两块背景色当成完整示范，也不要要求整个页面只能有两个离散色值。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --navy: #1A1A2E;
  --navy-dark: #10101F;
  --navy-light: #2A2A4A;
  --orange: #FF6B35;
  --orange-light: #FF8F66;
  --orange-pale: #FFE1D2;
  --orange-dark: #C9481A;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

# Japanese Minimalism / 日式极简

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Minimal · Classic · Warm / 极简 · 经典 · 温暖
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：2 Medium; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Personal / Blog / 个人 / 博客
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/japanese)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/japanese.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/japanese/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Use negative space, natural rhythm and careful content proportions.

用留白、自然节奏和细致的内容比例组织页面。

This study pairs paper tones, fine rules, serif headings and small vermilion accents; copy length sets the rhythm.

本例采用和纸色、细线、衬线标题与小面积朱红；文字长度决定排版节奏。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --paper: #f6f2e6;
  --paper-deep: #efe9d8;
  --ink: #2f3b38;
  --ink-soft: #6f6a5b;
  --clay: #8b7355;
  --sand: #c4a77d;
  --gold: #b08d3f;
  --seal: #a63a2b;
  --hair: rgba(139,115,85,.35);
  --serif: Georgia,"Palatino Linotype","Songti SC",serif;
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Japanese Minimalism. Use negative space, natural rhythm and careful content proportions. This study pairs paper tones, fine rules, serif headings and small vermilion accents; copy length sets the rhythm. Avoid reducing the aesthetic to an accumulation of seals, vertical text and empty space. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

日式极简。用留白、自然节奏和细致的内容比例组织页面。本例采用和纸色、细线、衬线标题与小面积朱红；文字长度决定排版节奏。避免把文化风格简化为印章、竖排与空白的堆砌。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Whitespace and fine rules can establish a measured reading rhythm
  - 中文：留白与细栏线可以形成缓慢阅读节奏
- Natural materials and paper tones support restrained surfaces
  - 中文：自然材质与纸色支持克制的表面表达
- Copy length can inform compositional proportions
  - 中文：文字长度可参与构图比例
- Small accent areas can preserve a clear focus
  - 中文：小面积强调色能保留清楚的重点

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Cultural imagery needs contextual understanding rather than collage
  - 中文：文化意象需要结合内容理解而非简单拼贴
- Excessive whitespace can push essential information out of the initial reading area
  - 中文：过量留白可能让必要信息离开首个阅读区
- Vertical text, serifs and font fallbacks need long Chinese-copy checks
  - 中文：竖排、衬线和字体回退需要检查中文长文

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Avoid reducing the aesthetic to an accumulation of seals, vertical text and empty space.
  - 中文：避免把文化风格简化为印章、竖排与空白的堆砌。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Muji · Kinfolk Magazine · Nakagawa Masashichi Shoten · Shiroiya

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

Reference file: japanese.html (354 source lines). Source and outputs can change together; retain the version and hash when recording an implementation decision.

# DESIGN.md — Japanese Minimalism / 日式极简

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Use negative space, natural rhythm and careful content proportions.

用留白、自然节奏和细致的内容比例组织页面。

This study pairs paper tones, fine rules, serif headings and small vermilion accents; copy length sets the rhythm.

本例采用和纸色、细线、衬线标题与小面积朱红；文字长度决定排版节奏。

Avoid / 避免：Avoid reducing the aesthetic to an accumulation of seals, vertical text and empty space. 避免把文化风格简化为印章、竖排与空白的堆砌。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --paper: #f6f2e6;
  --paper-deep: #efe9d8;
  --ink: #2f3b38;
  --ink-soft: #6f6a5b;
  --clay: #8b7355;
  --sand: #c4a77d;
  --gold: #b08d3f;
  --seal: #a63a2b;
  --hair: rgba(139,115,85,.35);
  --serif: Georgia,"Palatino Linotype","Songti SC",serif;
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Organic Design / 有机形态

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Modern · Playful / 现代 · 活泼
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：4 Expert; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Kids / Education / 儿童 / 教育
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/organic)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/organic.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/organic/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Create a flowing composition with asymmetric curves and natural imagery while keeping text clear.

以不对称的曲线和自然图像形成流动构图，文字保持清晰。

Shapes share a coherent curvature; gentle colors and forms guide reading.

形状之间有连续的曲率关系，色彩温和，图形帮助引导阅读。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --mint: #A8E6CF;
  --leaf: #DCEDC1;
  --peach: #FFD3B6;
  --coral: #FFAAA5;
  --coral-deep: #F08A84;
  --sea: #98D8C8;
  --ink: #33544A;
  --ink-soft: #5F7A70;
  --bg: #FFF9F0;
  --deep: #2E5347;
  --serif: Georgia, serif;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Organic Design. Create a flowing composition with asymmetric curves and natural imagery while keeping text clear. Shapes share a coherent curvature; gentle colors and forms guide reading. Do not squeeze every text container into a blob; organic form still needs layout discipline. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

有机形态。以不对称的曲线和自然图像形成流动构图，文字保持清晰。形状之间有连续的曲率关系，色彩温和，图形帮助引导阅读。不要把所有文字容器都挤进水滴；自然感不等于失去网格。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Asymmetric curves can connect content regions
  - 中文：不对称曲线可连接不同内容区域
- Natural images and gentle colors create continuous surfaces
  - 中文：自然图像与温和色彩形成连续表面
- Shapes can act as a supporting layer around the content
  - 中文：形状可作为内容之外的辅助视觉层
- Curvature and spacing rules can combine with an existing brand system
  - 中文：曲率和留白规则可与现有品牌系统组合

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Curved crops and overlaps need separate narrow-screen handling
  - 中文：曲线裁切和叠放需要单独处理窄屏
- Decorative shapes must not crowd copy or targets
  - 中文：装饰形状不能挤压正文或点击目标
- Complex paths and morphing motion need target-device rendering checks
  - 中文：复杂路径和形变动画需检查目标设备渲染

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Do not squeeze every text container into a blob; organic form still needs layout discipline.
  - 中文：不要把所有文字容器都挤进水滴；自然感不等于失去网格。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Stripe.com · Dropbox · Spotify · Mailchimp · Slack

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

Reference file: organic.html (310 source lines). Source and outputs can change together; retain the version and hash when recording an implementation decision.

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --mint: #A8E6CF;
  --leaf: #DCEDC1;
  --peach: #FFD3B6;
  --coral: #FFAAA5;
  --coral-deep: #F08A84;

  --ink: #33544A;

  --bg: #FFF9F0;
  --deep: #2E5347;
  --serif: Georgia, serif;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Liquid Glass / 液态玻璃

- Type / 类型：Material treatment / 材质表现
- Tags / 标签：Modern · Avant-garde / 现代 · 前卫
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：3 Hard; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：SaaS / Tech / SaaS / 科技产品
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/liquid-glass)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/liquid-glass.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/liquid-glass/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Place floating navigation and controls above a clear content layer; avoid turning all content into glass.

将浮动导航与控件放在清晰的内容层之上，避免整页内容都变成玻璃。

Focus on lensing, edge highlights, adaptive shadows and legibility over changing content; both light and dark contexts are valid.

关注透镜感、边缘高光、动态阴影和背景变化后的可读性；浅色与深色环境均可使用。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

A web material study of content/control separation, edge highlights and light/dark switching. CSS is an approximation of native real-time refraction, material merging and automatic legibility.

网页材质研究：示范内容与控件分层、边缘高光和亮暗切换。CSS 效果不等同于 Apple 原生的实时折射、材质融合与自动可读性处理。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

- [Apple · Meet Liquid Glass](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2025/219/)

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #f7f8fa;
  --ink: #19202b;
  --muted: #647084;
  --line: #dce1e8;
  --accent: #126be4;
  --glass: rgba(255,255,255,.52);
  --edge: rgba(255,255,255,.8);
  --shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(10,22,41,.16);
  --sans: "Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
  --radius: 28px;
  --blur: 12px;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Liquid Glass. Place floating navigation and controls above a clear content layer; avoid turning all content into glass. Focus on lensing, edge highlights, adaptive shadows and legibility over changing content; both light and dark contexts are valid. Do not equate it with more blur or treat dark glowing orbs and shadow removal as official requirements. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

液态玻璃。将浮动导航与控件放在清晰的内容层之上，避免整页内容都变成玻璃。关注透镜感、边缘高光、动态阴影和背景变化后的可读性；浅色与深色环境均可使用。不要等同于增加 blur，也不要把深色光晕和禁用阴影当作官方规则。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Floating controls can be separated clearly from content
  - 中文：浮动控件与内容层可以明确分离
- Edge highlights can describe the material boundary
  - 中文：边缘高光可标示材质轮廓
- Visible background variation can express spatial layers
  - 中文：透过背景的变化可表现空间层次
- Solid content areas can carry long copy and data
  - 中文：可以保留实色内容区承载长文与数据

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- A CSS web treatment only approximates native material
  - 中文：CSS 网页效果只能近似原生材质
- Text and icon contrast need checking over changing light and dark backgrounds
  - 中文：明暗背景变化时需要检查文字与图标对比
- Provide a solid fallback without blur support and measure rendering on target devices
  - 中文：需提供不支持模糊时的实色回退并实测渲染

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Do not equate it with more blur or treat dark glowing orbs and shadow removal as official requirements.
  - 中文：不要等同于增加 blur，也不要把深色光晕和禁用阴影当作官方规则。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

iOS 26 · macOS Tahoe · visionOS · Apple.com

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Liquid Glass / 液态玻璃

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Place floating navigation and controls above a clear content layer; avoid turning all content into glass.

将浮动导航与控件放在清晰的内容层之上，避免整页内容都变成玻璃。

Focus on lensing, edge highlights, adaptive shadows and legibility over changing content; both light and dark contexts are valid.

关注透镜感、边缘高光、动态阴影和背景变化后的可读性；浅色与深色环境均可使用。

Avoid / 避免：Do not equate it with more blur or treat dark glowing orbs and shadow removal as official requirements. 不要等同于增加 blur，也不要把深色光晕和禁用阴影当作官方规则。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #f7f8fa;
  --ink: #19202b;
  --muted: #647084;
  --line: #dce1e8;
  --accent: #126be4;
  --glass: rgba(255,255,255,.52);
  --edge: rgba(255,255,255,.8);
  --shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(10,22,41,.16);
  --sans: "Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
  --radius: 28px;
  --blur: 12px;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。

- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。
