# Editorial / 报刊编辑风

- Type / 类型：Layout pattern / 布局模式
- Tags / 标签：Classic · Distinctive · Art / 经典 · 个性 · 艺术
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：2 Medium; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Creative / Design / 创意 / 设计, Art / Culture / 艺术 / 文化, Personal / Blog / 个人 / 博客
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/editorial)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/editorial.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/editorial/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Masthead, article hierarchy, column measure, captions and fine rules establish reading order.

报头、文章层级、正文栏宽、图片说明和细栏线共同建立阅读顺序。

Serif headlines, compact body copy, a drop cap and a lead image set the reading rhythm in this study.

本例用衬线标题、紧凑正文、首字下沉和一幅主图；重点是长文阅读的节奏。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

- [The Guardian · Digital design guide](https://design.theguardian.com/)

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --paper: #FAF7F0;
  --ink: #141414;
  --ink-soft: #3E3A33;
  --accent: #C8102E;
  --grey: #8A857C;
  --hairline: #DCD5C6;
  --serif: "Source Serif 4",Georgia,"Iowan Old Style","Times New Roman",Times,serif;
  --display: Didot,"Bodoni 72","Didot LT STD",Georgia,serif;
  --sans: "Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Editorial. Masthead, article hierarchy, column measure, captions and fine rules establish reading order. Serif headlines, compact body copy, a drop cap and a lead image set the reading rhythm in this study. Avoid making every sentence a display headline; retain paragraphs, attribution and captions. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

报刊编辑风。报头、文章层级、正文栏宽、图片说明和细栏线共同建立阅读顺序。本例用衬线标题、紧凑正文、首字下沉和一幅主图；重点是长文阅读的节奏。避免所有文案都变成超大标题，保留完整段落、出处和图片说明。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Mastheads, rules and captions establish article hierarchy
  - 中文：报头、栏线与图片说明建立文章层级
- Body measure and line spacing can be tuned to the reading content
  - 中文：正文栏宽与行距可围绕阅读内容调整
- Typographic contrast can carry the main visual expression
  - 中文：字体对比可以承担主要视觉表达
- Attribution and captions have defined positions in the composition
  - 中文：出处和图注有明确的版面位置

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Long-form layouts need real copy rather than short placeholders
  - 中文：长文需要实际内容验证而非占位短句
- Multi-column content needs an explicit mobile reading order
  - 中文：多栏内容必须定义手机端的阅读顺序
- Chinese serif fallbacks and mixed scripts need checks at each breakpoint
  - 中文：中文衬线回退和混排需要逐断点检查

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Avoid making every sentence a display headline; retain paragraphs, attribution and captions.
  - 中文：避免所有文案都变成超大标题，保留完整段落、出处和图片说明。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

NYTimes.com · The New Yorker · Monocle · The Economist

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Editorial / 报刊编辑风

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Masthead, article hierarchy, column measure, captions and fine rules establish reading order.

报头、文章层级、正文栏宽、图片说明和细栏线共同建立阅读顺序。

Serif headlines, compact body copy, a drop cap and a lead image set the reading rhythm in this study.

本例用衬线标题、紧凑正文、首字下沉和一幅主图；重点是长文阅读的节奏。

Avoid / 避免：Avoid making every sentence a display headline; retain paragraphs, attribution and captions. 避免所有文案都变成超大标题，保留完整段落、出处和图片说明。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --paper: #FAF7F0;
  --ink: #141414;
  --ink-soft: #3E3A33;
  --accent: #C8102E;
  --grey: #8A857C;
  --hairline: #DCD5C6;
  --serif: "Source Serif 4",Georgia,"Iowan Old Style","Times New Roman",Times,serif;
  --display: Didot,"Bodoni 72","Didot LT STD",Georgia,serif;
  --sans: "Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Brutalism / 粗野主义

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Avant-garde · Distinctive / 前卫 · 个性
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：1 Easy; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Art / Culture / 艺术 / 文化
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/brutalism)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/brutalism.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/brutalism/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Use direct document structure, emphatic type and visible links for a raw web character.

用直接的文档结构、强文字层级与显露的链接建立原始网页感。

This study uses browser-like serif type, square corners, fine rules and link blue with dense content.

本例使用浏览器式衬线体、直角、细线与链接蓝，保留内容密度。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #FFFFFF;
  --fg: #000000;
  --link: #0000EE;
  --visited: #551A8B;
  --hl: #FFFF00;
  --red: #FF0000;
  --green: #00FF00;
  --serif: Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Brutalism. Use direct document structure, emphatic type and visible links for a raw web character. This study uses browser-like serif type, square corners, fine rules and link blue with dense content. Deliberate roughness still needs navigation and readability; broken layout is not a design principle. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

粗野主义。用直接的文档结构、强文字层级与显露的链接建立原始网页感。本例使用浏览器式衬线体、直角、细线与链接蓝，保留内容密度。刻意粗粝也需要清楚的导航和可读性，不要把损坏布局当成风格。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Visible links and direct document structure expose navigation
  - 中文：显露链接与直接文档结构让导航可见
- Type, fine rules and square corners can form a complete surface language
  - 中文：文字、细线与直角可以构成完整表面
- Native browser controls and system fonts are usable choices
  - 中文：可采用浏览器原生控件与系统字体
- Paragraphs and dividers can organize dense content
  - 中文：内容密度可通过段落和分隔线组织

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Deliberate roughness still needs hierarchy and reading order
  - 中文：刻意粗粝仍需明确的层级与阅读顺序
- Native control appearance varies across browsers
  - 中文：原生控件的外观在不同浏览器中有差异
- Experimental layout must not obscure focus, links or touch targets
  - 中文：实验排版不能遮挡焦点、链接或触控目标
- Brand expression needs to work with everyday functional use
  - 中文：品牌表达需要与功能页面的日常使用协调

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Deliberate roughness still needs navigation and readability; broken layout is not a design principle.
  - 中文：刻意粗粝也需要清楚的导航和可读性，不要把损坏布局当成风格。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

brutalistwebsites.com · Craigslist · Bloomberg.com (partially) · Hacker News

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css

  --bg: #FFFFFF;
  --fg: #000000;
  --link: #0000EE;
  --visited: #551A8B;
  --hl: #FFFF00;
  --red: #FF0000;
  --green: #00FF00;
  --serif: Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

Reference HTML: https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/brutalism.html

# Terminal / 终端黑客风

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Vintage · Distinctive / 复古 · 个性
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：1 Easy; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Personal / Blog / 个人 / 博客
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/terminal)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/terminal.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/terminal/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Organize content as commands, output, logs and status in a terminal reading sequence.

按命令、输出、日志与状态组织内容，保留终端的阅读顺序。

Monospace type, a limited palette, cursor and explicit success/error states.

等宽字、有限色盘、光标与清楚的成功/失败状态。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #060907;
  --bg-panel: #0A0F0B;
  --fg: #33FF66;
  --fg-bright: #E8FFE8;
  --fg-dim: #1E9E4A;
  --fg-faint: #0F5F2E;
  --warn: #FFB000;
  --line: #12331E;
  --glow: rgba(51,255,102,.35);
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Terminal. Organize content as commands, output, logs and status in a terminal reading sequence. Monospace type, a limited palette, cursor and explicit success/error states. Avoid meaningless code and persistent blinking; commands should be readable and purposeful. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

终端黑客风。按命令、输出、日志与状态组织内容，保留终端的阅读顺序。等宽字、有限色盘、光标与清楚的成功/失败状态。避免满屏无意义代码和持续闪烁；命令示例要可读且说明用途。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Commands, output and logs can provide a clear content structure
  - 中文：命令、输出与日志可形成明确的内容结构
- Monospace type helps align short commands and numbers
  - 中文：等宽字体便于对齐短命令与数字
- A limited palette can assign roles to success, error and hints
  - 中文：有限色盘可为成功、失败和提示分配角色
- Type can establish the atmosphere without relying on images
  - 中文：可主要依靠文字而非图片建立氛围

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Command metaphors need explanations for people unfamiliar with terminals
  - 中文：命令隐喻需要为不了解终端的用户补充说明
- Long copy needs suitable measure and type to avoid crowding
  - 中文：长文应调整行宽与字体以避免拥挤
- Blinking cursors and scanlines need a disable or reduced-motion option
  - 中文：闪烁光标和扫描线需要关闭或减弱选项

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Avoid meaningless code and persistent blinking; commands should be readable and purposeful.
  - 中文：避免满屏无意义代码和持续闪烁；命令示例要可读且说明用途。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Warp.dev · Charm.sh · asciinema.org · cool-retro-term

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Terminal / 终端黑客风

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Organize content as commands, output, logs and status in a terminal reading sequence.

按命令、输出、日志与状态组织内容，保留终端的阅读顺序。

Monospace type, a limited palette, cursor and explicit success/error states.

等宽字、有限色盘、光标与清楚的成功/失败状态。

Avoid / 避免：Avoid meaningless code and persistent blinking; commands should be readable and purposeful. 避免满屏无意义代码和持续闪烁；命令示例要可读且说明用途。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #060907;
  --bg-panel: #0A0F0B;
  --fg: #33FF66;
  --fg-bright: #E8FFE8;
  --fg-dim: #1E9E4A;
  --fg-faint: #0F5F2E;
  --warn: #FFB000;
  --line: #12331E;
  --glow: rgba(51,255,102,.35);
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

# Memphis / 孟菲斯

- Type / 类型：Design movement / 设计流派
- Tags / 标签：Art · Playful · Vintage / 艺术 · 活泼 · 复古
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：2 Medium; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Art / Culture / 艺术 / 文化, Kids / Education / 儿童 / 教育
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/memphis)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/memphis.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/memphis/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Build a playful layout through rhythmic geometry, patterns and color blocks.

用有节奏的几何图形、图案与色块构成活泼版面。

Squiggles, dots, diagonals and clashing colors are arranged around the headline and objects in this study.

本例采用波浪、圆点、斜线和撞色，装饰围绕主标题与商品排列。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --cream: #FFF8EC;
  --pink: #FF69B4;
  --teal: #00CED1;
  --gold: #FFD700;
  --tomato: #FF6347;
  --ink: #000000;
  --paper: #FFFFFF;
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Memphis. Build a playful layout through rhythmic geometry, patterns and color blocks. Squiggles, dots, diagonals and clashing colors are arranged around the headline and objects in this study. Avoid distributing every pattern equally; retain quiet areas for reading. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

孟菲斯。用有节奏的几何图形、图案与色块构成活泼版面。本例采用波浪、圆点、斜线和撞色，装饰围绕主标题与商品排列。不要让所有图案等量出现；保留安静区域支撑阅读。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Dots, lines and squiggles can form a repeating graphic language
  - 中文：点、线与波浪可组成重复的图形语言
- Clashing colors can separate content regions
  - 中文：撞色能划分不同内容区域
- Pattern density can be arranged around the main heading
  - 中文：图案密度可以围绕主标题分配
- Geometry can extend into event and product graphics
  - 中文：几何元素可延伸为活动和商品图形

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Body copy needs quiet surrounding areas for readability
  - 中文：正文周围需要安静区域维持可读性
- Too many patterns can compete with the primary action
  - 中文：过多图案会与主要操作争夺注意
- Decorative overlaps need narrow-screen crop and occlusion checks
  - 中文：装饰叠放需要检查窄屏裁切与遮挡

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Avoid distributing every pattern equally; retain quiet areas for reading.
  - 中文：不要让所有图案等量出现；保留安静区域支撑阅读。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Ettore Sottsass works · Memphis Milano · Camper shoes · Moschino collections

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Memphis / 孟菲斯

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Build a playful layout through rhythmic geometry, patterns and color blocks.

用有节奏的几何图形、图案与色块构成活泼版面。

Squiggles, dots, diagonals and clashing colors are arranged around the headline and objects in this study.

本例采用波浪、圆点、斜线和撞色，装饰围绕主标题与商品排列。

Avoid / 避免：Avoid distributing every pattern equally; retain quiet areas for reading. 不要让所有图案等量出现；保留安静区域支撑阅读。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --cream: #FFF8EC;
  --pink: #FF69B4;
  --teal: #00CED1;
  --gold: #FFD700;
  --tomato: #FF6347;
  --ink: #000000;
  --paper: #FFFFFF;
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Art Deco / 装饰艺术

- Type / 类型：Design movement / 设计流派
- Tags / 标签：Classic · Vintage / 经典 · 复古
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：3 Hard; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Art / Culture / 艺术 / 文化
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/art-deco)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/art-deco.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/art-deco/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Create ceremony with symmetry, stepped composition and ornamental framing.

用对称轴、阶梯形构图和装饰边框建立仪式感。

This study uses green-black, fine gold lines, radiating forms and widely spaced headlines.

本例用深绿黑、金色细线、放射形与宽字距标题。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #0B0E0C;
  --panel: #101713;
  --gold: #D4AF37;
  --gold-dim: #8C7325;
  --gold-soft: rgba(212,175,55,.45);
  --silver: #C0C0C0;
  --cream: #EFE6CF;
  --serif: Georgia,"Palatino Linotype","Songti SC",serif;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Art Deco. Create ceremony with symmetry, stepped composition and ornamental framing. This study uses green-black, fine gold lines, radiating forms and widely spaced headlines. Black and gold alone are insufficient; geometric proportion and ornamental rhythm carry identity. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

装饰艺术。用对称轴、阶梯形构图和装饰边框建立仪式感。本例用深绿黑、金色细线、放射形与宽字距标题。不要只靠黑金配色；几何比例和装饰节奏才构成辨识度。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Symmetry and stepped outlines create a ceremonial composition
  - 中文：对称轴和阶梯轮廓形成仪式化构图
- Fine-line frames can give content a defined structure
  - 中文：细线边框可为内容设置明确框架
- Tracked headlines can echo geometric ornament
  - 中文：宽字距标题与几何装饰形成呼应
- Metallic colors and dark surfaces can express material contrast
  - 中文：金属色与深色表面可表现材质对比

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Ornament proportions need adjustment for headline length
  - 中文：装饰比例需要随标题长度调整
- Fine rules and small gold type need contrast and legibility checks
  - 中文：细线和金色小字需要检查对比与清晰度
- Narrow screens need simplified frames and symmetrical layouts
  - 中文：窄屏需要简化边框与对称布局
- Graphics, type and imagery need a coherent period vocabulary
  - 中文：图形、字体和图片应采用一致的时代语汇

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Black and gold alone are insufficient; geometric proportion and ornamental rhythm carry identity.
  - 中文：不要只靠黑金配色；几何比例和装饰节奏才构成辨识度。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

The Great Gatsby · Chrysler Building · The Savoy London · Tiffany & Co.

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Glassmorphism / 玻璃拟态

- Type / 类型：Material treatment / 材质表现
- Tags / 标签：Modern / 现代
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：3 Hard; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：SaaS / Tech / SaaS / 科技产品
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/glassmorphism)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/glassmorphism.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/glassmorphism/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Place a small number of translucent panels over a background with visible color and form.

把少量半透明面板放在具有颜色与轮廓的背景之前。

Backdrop blur, transparent fills, fine light borders and moderate shadows express frosted glass; the background must remain perceptible.

背景模糊、透明填充、细亮边与适量阴影共同表达磨砂玻璃；背景必须能被感知。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

- [Microsoft Fluent · Acrylic material](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/design/style/acrylic)

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --bg0: #0d0f26;
  --bg1: #171a3d;
  --fg: #f4f5ff;
  --muted: rgba(230,233,255,.68);
  --faint: rgba(230,233,255,.42);
  --pink: #FF6B9D;
  --teal: #4ECDC4;
  --indigo: #667EEA;
  --violet: #9b6bff;
  --glass: rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --glass-strong: rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  --stroke: rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  --stroke-soft: rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  --shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(4,7,28,.5);
  --sans: "Inter",-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Glassmorphism. Place a small number of translucent panels over a background with visible color and form. Backdrop blur, transparent fills, fine light borders and moderate shadows express frosted glass; the background must remain perceptible. Avoid opaque cards and indiscriminate blur stacks; prioritize text contrast. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

玻璃拟态。把少量半透明面板放在具有颜色与轮廓的背景之前。背景模糊、透明填充、细亮边与适量阴影共同表达磨砂玻璃；背景必须能被感知。避免不透明卡片或多层无差别模糊；先保证文字对比。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Translucent panels can retain background color and form
  - 中文：透明面板可保留背景的色彩与轮廓
- Fine borders and shadows can distinguish overlapping layers
  - 中文：细边框与阴影可区分叠放关系
- Local glass surfaces can combine with stable solid content areas
  - 中文：局部玻璃可以与稳定的实色内容区组合
- The material approach can work with light or dark palettes
  - 中文：明暗配色均可采用同一材质思路

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Text and icon contrast need rechecking as the background changes
  - 中文：背景变化时需要重新检查文本与图标对比
- Nested blur layers need rendering measurements on target devices
  - 中文：嵌套模糊层需在目标设备上测量渲染耗时
- A solid fallback is needed without backdrop-filter support
  - 中文：不支持 backdrop-filter 时需要实色回退
- Too little or too much transparency can weaken material and hierarchy
  - 中文：透明度过低或过高都会弱化材质与层级

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Avoid opaque cards and indiscriminate blur stacks; prioritize text contrast.
  - 中文：避免不透明卡片或多层无差别模糊；先保证文字对比。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

macOS Big Sur · iOS Control Center · Windows 11 · Linear.app · Figma

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Glassmorphism / 玻璃拟态

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Place a small number of translucent panels over a background with visible color and form.

把少量半透明面板放在具有颜色与轮廓的背景之前。

Backdrop blur, transparent fills, fine light borders and moderate shadows express frosted glass; the background must remain perceptible.

背景模糊、透明填充、细亮边与适量阴影共同表达磨砂玻璃；背景必须能被感知。

Avoid / 避免：Avoid opaque cards and indiscriminate blur stacks; prioritize text contrast. 避免不透明卡片或多层无差别模糊；先保证文字对比。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --bg0: #0d0f26;
  --bg1: #171a3d;
  --fg: #f4f5ff;
  --muted: rgba(230,233,255,.68);
  --faint: rgba(230,233,255,.42);
  --pink: #FF6B9D;
  --teal: #4ECDC4;
  --indigo: #667EEA;
  --violet: #9b6bff;
  --glass: rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --glass-strong: rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  --stroke: rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  --stroke-soft: rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  --shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(4,7,28,.5);
  --sans: "Inter",-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

# Dark Academia / 暗黑学院

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Classic · Vintage / 经典 · 复古
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：2 Medium; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Art / Culture / 艺术 / 文化
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/dark-academia)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/dark-academia.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/dark-academia/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Organize content around books, scholarship and reading, with a long-form typographic hierarchy.

以书籍、知识与阅读场景组织内容，采用适合长文的文字层级。

Dark wood, forest green, wine and parchment with restrained serif type and material detail.

深木色、墨绿、酒红和纸色，搭配克制的衬线体与材质细节。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #1A130C;
  --panel: #241A11;
  --green: #26382F;
  --green-deep: #1C2A23;
  --parchment: #EADCBE;
  --ink: #CDBD9C;
  --wine: #722F37;
  --wine-deep: #59242B;
  --brass: #B08D57;
  --candle: #EFA94A;
  --serif: Georgia,"Palatino Linotype","Songti SC",serif;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Dark Academia. Organize content around books, scholarship and reading, with a long-form typographic hierarchy. Dark wood, forest green, wine and parchment with restrained serif type and material detail. Do not sacrifice body contrast to darkness or merely pile on vintage ornament. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

暗黑学院。以书籍、知识与阅读场景组织内容，采用适合长文的文字层级。深木色、墨绿、酒红和纸色，搭配克制的衬线体与材质细节。不要把背景压黑到看不清正文，也不要只堆叠复古装饰。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Books, paper and wood tones can establish a reading setting
  - 中文：书籍、纸张与木色可建立阅读场景
- Serif headings can coordinate with a detailed body hierarchy
  - 中文：衬线标题与细致的正文层级能够协调
- Dark wood, forest green and parchment can separate surfaces
  - 中文：深木色、墨绿与纸色能划分表面层次
- Captions, quotations and sources can be integrated into the layout
  - 中文：图注、引文与来源可以融入版面

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Dark surfaces must preserve body and secondary-text contrast
  - 中文：深色底不能牺牲正文和次要信息对比
- Material textures must avoid interfering with long copy
  - 中文：材质纹理需要避免干扰长文
- Old-book and art imagery needs source-license checks
  - 中文：旧书与艺术图像需要核实素材授权
- Modern controls still need explicit interactive states
  - 中文：现代操作控件需要保持明确的可点击状态

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Do not sacrifice body contrast to darkness or merely pile on vintage ornament.
  - 中文：不要把背景压黑到看不清正文，也不要只堆叠复古装饰。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Oxford University Press · Penguin Classics · The School of Life · Hogwarts Legacy

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Dark Academia / 暗黑学院

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Organize content around books, scholarship and reading, with a long-form typographic hierarchy.

以书籍、知识与阅读场景组织内容，采用适合长文的文字层级。

Dark wood, forest green, wine and parchment with restrained serif type and material detail.

深木色、墨绿、酒红和纸色，搭配克制的衬线体与材质细节。

Avoid / 避免：Do not sacrifice body contrast to darkness or merely pile on vintage ornament. 不要把背景压黑到看不清正文，也不要只堆叠复古装饰。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #1A130C;
  --panel: #241A11;
  --green: #26382F;
  --green-deep: #1C2A23;
  --parchment: #EADCBE;
  --ink: #CDBD9C;
  --wine: #722F37;
  --wine-deep: #59242B;
  --brass: #B08D57;
  --candle: #EFA94A;
  --serif: Georgia,"Palatino Linotype","Songti SC",serif;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Pixel Art / 像素风

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Vintage · Playful · Distinctive / 复古 · 活泼 · 个性
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：2 Medium; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Gaming / Entertainment / 游戏 / 娱乐
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/pixel)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/pixel.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/pixel/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Build on a consistent pixel unit and arrange information like a game HUD.

将界面建立在统一像素单位上，按游戏 HUD 的信息层级布局。

Limited palette, stepped edges, hard shadows and stepped motion; type and sprites share a pixel rhythm.

有限色盘、阶梯边缘、硬阴影和 steps 跳帧动效；标题与图形共享像素节奏。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --night: #1A1C2C;
  --panel: #29366F;
  --steel: #333C57;
  --mist: #94B0C2;
  --snow: #F4F4F4;
  --tomato: #B13E53;
  --ember: #EF7D57;
  --sun: #FFCD75;
  --lime: #A7F070;
  --leaf: #38B764;
  --sky: #41A6F6;
  --ice: #73EFF7;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,"Courier New",monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Pixel Art. Build on a consistent pixel unit and arrange information like a game HUD. Limited palette, stepped edges, hard shadows and stepped motion; type and sprites share a pixel rhythm. Avoid soft focus, arbitrary fractional scaling and rounded corners; monospace is not automatically pixel type. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

像素风。将界面建立在统一像素单位上，按游戏 HUD 的信息层级布局。有限色盘、阶梯边缘、硬阴影和 steps 跳帧动效；标题与图形共享像素节奏。避免柔焦、任意小数缩放和圆角；普通等宽字体不自动成为像素字体。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- A shared pixel unit can connect type and graphics
  - 中文：统一像素单位可以连接字体与图形
- Stepped edges and hard shadows create consistent outlines
  - 中文：阶梯边缘与硬阴影形成一致轮廓
- HUD patterns can organize status and game-like information
  - 中文：HUD 模式可组织状态与游戏化信息
- A limited palette supports distinct state roles
  - 中文：有限色盘支持明确的状态角色

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Pixel assets need manual checks for proportions and integer scaling
  - 中文：像素资产需要人工检查比例与整数缩放
- Body copy needs readable type and checked Chinese fallbacks
  - 中文：正文应采用可读字体并检查中文回退
- Stepped motion must not interfere with essential copy or controls
  - 中文：跳帧动画不能影响关键文字与操作

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Avoid soft focus, arbitrary fractional scaling and rounded corners; monospace is not automatically pixel type.
  - 中文：避免柔焦、任意小数缩放和圆角；普通等宽字体不自动成为像素字体。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Celeste · Stardew Valley · itch.io · Poolsuite.net

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

Reference file: pixel.html (402 source lines). Source and outputs can change together; retain the version and hash when recording an implementation decision.
