These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css

  --panel: #29366F;

  --lime: #A7F070;
  --leaf: #38B764;
  --sky: #41A6F6;
  --ice: #73EFF7;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,"Courier New",monospace;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Cyberpunk / 赛博朋克

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Avant-garde · Distinctive / 前卫 · 个性
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：3 Hard; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Gaming / Entertainment / 游戏 / 娱乐
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/cyberpunk)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/cyberpunk.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/cyberpunk/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Use strong light-dark contrast, technical labeling and asymmetric information regions for a futuristic urban character.

用强烈的明暗对比、技术标识和非对称信息区营造未来城市感。

Use cyan, magenta and warning colors selectively over dark surfaces; clipped corners and brief glitches support hierarchy.

深色基底上有限使用青、品红与警示色，切角和短暂故障动效服务层级。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #050508;
  --bg-panel: #0a0a12;
  --bg-card: #0c0c16;
  --cyan: #00ffff;
  --magenta: #ff00ff;
  --yellow: #ffff00;
  --pink: #ff1493;
  --fg: #c9d6e2;
  --fg-dim: #5f6e80;
  --line: rgba(0,255,255,.22);
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Cyberpunk. Use strong light-dark contrast, technical labeling and asymmetric information regions for a futuristic urban character. Use cyan, magenta and warning colors selectively over dark surfaces; clipped corners and brief glitches support hierarchy. Avoid neon on all text and persistent glitches that interrupt reading or interaction. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

赛博朋克。用强烈的明暗对比、技术标识和非对称信息区营造未来城市感。深色基底上有限使用青、品红与警示色，切角和短暂故障动效服务层级。不要给所有文字加霓虹光，避免持续故障影响阅读与操作。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Dark regions and selective neon accents establish light-dark hierarchy
  - 中文：深色区域与少量霓虹强调形成明暗层级
- Clipped corners and technical labels can form a shared visual vocabulary
  - 中文：切角与技术标签可形成统一图形语汇
- Asymmetric regions can arrange tasks, status and narrative content
  - 中文：非对称区域可安排任务、状态与叙事内容
- Brief glitch effects can be used for nonessential decoration
  - 中文：短暂故障效果可用于非关键装饰

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Glowing edges cannot replace text contrast and focus indicators
  - 中文：发光边缘不能替代正文对比与焦点标识
- Technical decoration needs a relationship with real content
  - 中文：技术装饰需要与真实内容建立关系
- Continuous motion needs pause and reduced-motion handling
  - 中文：持续动画需有暂停和减弱动态效果的处理
- Multiple filters and large images need measurements on target devices
  - 中文：多重滤镜与大图需在目标设备上测量

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Avoid neon on all text and persistent glitches that interrupt reading or interaction.
  - 中文：不要给所有文字加霓虹光，避免持续故障影响阅读与操作。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Cyberpunk 2077 · Blade Runner 2049 · Cyberpunk: Edgerunners · AKIRA

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Cyberpunk / 赛博朋克

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Use strong light-dark contrast, technical labeling and asymmetric information regions for a futuristic urban character.

用强烈的明暗对比、技术标识和非对称信息区营造未来城市感。

Use cyan, magenta and warning colors selectively over dark surfaces; clipped corners and brief glitches support hierarchy.

深色基底上有限使用青、品红与警示色，切角和短暂故障动效服务层级。

Avoid / 避免：Avoid neon on all text and persistent glitches that interrupt reading or interaction. 不要给所有文字加霓虹光，避免持续故障影响阅读与操作。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #050508;
  --bg-panel: #0a0a12;
  --bg-card: #0c0c16;
  --cyan: #00ffff;
  --magenta: #ff00ff;
  --yellow: #ffff00;
  --pink: #ff1493;
  --fg: #c9d6e2;
  --fg-dim: #5f6e80;
  --line: rgba(0,255,255,.22);
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. # Frutiger Aero / Frutiger Aero

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Vintage · Playful / 复古 · 活泼
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：4 Expert; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Kids / Education / 儿童 / 教育
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/frutiger-aero)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/frutiger-aero.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/frutiger-aero/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Combine natural imagery and optimistic technology in one bright scene.

让自然意象与乐观的技术界面共享一幅明亮场景。

Sky, water, grass green, translucent highlights and soft corners, with consistent lighting and reflection.

天空、水、草绿、透亮高光与柔和圆角；光照方向与反射保持一致。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #BDE8FF;
  --bg-soft: #E8F7FF;
  --bg-card: #FFFFFF;
  --fg: #1B4A6B;
  --fg-soft: #48759B;
  --accent: #8FD400;
  --accent-deep: #69A917;
  --accent-soft: #A8E04E;
  --aqua: #4CA6E8;
  --aqua-deep: #2E86C9;
  --sun: #FFC93C;
  --glow: #4CA6E847;
  --hi: #FFFe;
  --sans: "Segoe UI","Frutiger","Frutiger Linotype",Verdana,Tahoma,-apple-system,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Frutiger Aero. Combine natural imagery and optimistic technology in one bright scene. Sky, water, grass green, translucent highlights and soft corners, with consistent lighting and reflection. Blue-green gradients alone are insufficient; natural content and glossy material must coexist. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

Frutiger Aero。让自然意象与乐观的技术界面共享一幅明亮场景。天空、水、草绿、透亮高光与柔和圆角；光照方向与反射保持一致。不要只剩蓝绿渐变；自然内容与光泽材质需要同时存在。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Natural imagery and glossy surfaces can share a bright scene
  - 中文：自然图像与光泽表面可共享明亮场景
- Sky, water and plants can connect page regions
  - 中文：天空、水与绿植可以连接不同页面区域
- Highlights and reflections can express control volume
  - 中文：高光与反射可表达控件体积
- Blue-green foundations can be separated from white content layers
  - 中文：蓝绿基底与白色内容层可以相互区分

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Lighting, reflections and imagery need consistent direction
  - 中文：光照、反射与图像需要保持方向一致
- Gloss must preserve copy, boundaries and control states
  - 中文：光泽不能弱化文字、边界和操作状态
- Natural image crops and licenses need individual checks
  - 中文：自然素材的裁切与授权需要逐项确认

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Blue-green gradients alone are insufficient; natural content and glossy material must coexist.
  - 中文：不要只剩蓝绿渐变；自然内容与光泽材质需要同时存在。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

Windows Vista · Wii Menu · iTunes 7 · Frutiger Aero Archive

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Frutiger Aero / Frutiger Aero

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Combine natural imagery and optimistic technology in one bright scene.

让自然意象与乐观的技术界面共享一幅明亮场景。

Sky, water, grass green, translucent highlights and soft corners, with consistent lighting and reflection.

天空、水、草绿、透亮高光与柔和圆角；光照方向与反射保持一致。

Avoid / 避免：Blue-green gradients alone are insufficient; natural content and glossy material must coexist. 不要只剩蓝绿渐变；自然内容与光泽材质需要同时存在。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #BDE8FF;
  --bg-soft: #E8F7FF;
  --bg-card: #FFFFFF;
  --fg: #1B4A6B;
  --fg-soft: #48759B;
  --accent: #8FD400;
  --accent-deep: #69A917;
  --accent-soft: #A8E04E;
  --aqua: #4CA6E8;
  --aqua-deep: #2E86C9;
  --sun: #FFC93C;
  --glow: #4CA6E847;
  --hi: #FFFe;
  --sans: "Segoe UI","Frutiger","Frutiger Linotype",Verdana,Tahoma,-apple-system,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Claymorphism / 粘土拟态

- Type / 类型：Material treatment / 材质表现
- Tags / 标签：Modern · Playful / 现代 · 活泼
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：4 Expert; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Gaming / Entertainment / 游戏 / 娱乐, Kids / Education / 儿童 / 教育
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/claymorphism)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/claymorphism.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/claymorphism/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Focus on a few voluminous characters or controls with space around them.

以少量体积饱满的角色或控件为视觉重点，留出呼吸空间。

Soft corners, inset highlights and tinted cast shadows create an inflated volume under consistent lighting.

柔软圆角、内高光与带色外阴影形成膨胀感，光照保持统一。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --pink: #FFB6C1;
  --pink-deep: #F79CAC;
  --sky: #87CEEB;
  --sky-deep: #6FBBDD;
  --mint: #98FB98;
  --mint-deep: #7FE39C;
  --plum: #DDA0DD;
  --plum-deep: #C98BD1;
  --peach: #FFDAB9;
  --peach-deep: #FFC69B;
  --cream: #FFF9F4;
  --ink: #5F4B78;
  --muted: #94819F;
  --bg1: #FFF2F6;
  --bg2: #F3EDFC;
  --bg3: #EAF7F4;
  --shadow-plum: rgba(201,139,209,.32);
  --hi: rgba(255,255,255,.9);
  --lo: rgba(122,82,140,.16);
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Claymorphism. Focus on a few voluminous characters or controls with space around them. Soft corners, inset highlights and tinted cast shadows create an inflated volume under consistent lighting. A drop shadow on a flat card is not clay; keep characters away from controls. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

粘土拟态。以少量体积饱满的角色或控件为视觉重点，留出呼吸空间。柔软圆角、内高光与带色外阴影形成膨胀感，光照保持统一。避免用普通卡片加投影冒充粘土；避免装饰角色遮挡操作。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Inset highlights and cast shadows can express soft volume
  - 中文：内高光与外阴影可以表现柔软体积
- Rounded characters can provide a local visual focus
  - 中文：圆润角色可成为局部视觉重点
- Consistent lighting can connect graphics and controls
  - 中文：统一光照可以连接不同图形与控件
- Material focal points can combine with clear text surfaces
  - 中文：材质重点可与清楚的文字表面组合

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Complex characters may need dedicated illustration or 3D assets
  - 中文：复杂角色可能需要专门的插画或 3D 资产
- Layered shadows and large assets need target-device measurements
  - 中文：叠加阴影与大资产需在目标设备上测量
- Inflated contours must not crowd forms and target areas
  - 中文：膨胀轮廓不能压缩表单和点击区域

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- A drop shadow on a flat card is not clay; keep characters away from controls.
  - 中文：避免用普通卡片加投影冒充粘土；避免装饰角色遮挡操作。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Android 12 Logo · Reddit Snoo · Windows 11 Emoji · Notion AI

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。

## Style principles / 风格原则

以少量体积饱满的角色或控件为视觉重点，留出呼吸空间。

Soft corners, inset highlights and tinted cast shadows create an inflated volume under consistent lighting.

柔软圆角、内高光与带色外阴影形成膨胀感，光照保持统一。

Avoid / 避免：A drop shadow on a flat card is not clay; keep characters away from controls. 避免用普通卡片加投影冒充粘土；避免装饰角色遮挡操作。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --pink: #FFB6C1;
  --pink-deep: #F79CAC;
  --sky: #87CEEB;
  --sky-deep: #6FBBDD;
  --mint: #98FB98;
  --mint-deep: #7FE39C;
  --plum: #DDA0DD;
  --plum-deep: #C98BD1;
  --peach: #FFDAB9;
  --peach-deep: #FFC69B;
  --cream: #FFF9F4;
  --ink: #5F4B78;
  --muted: #94819F;
  --bg1: #FFF2F6;
  --bg2: #F3EDFC;
  --bg3: #EAF7F4;
  --shadow-plum: rgba(201,139,209,.32);
  --hi: rgba(255,255,255,.9);
  --lo: rgba(122,82,140,.16);
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Vaporwave / 蒸汽波

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Art · Vintage / 艺术 · 复古
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：3 Hard; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Gaming / Entertainment / 游戏 / 娱乐
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/vaporwave)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/vaporwave.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/vaporwave/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Combine retro windows, perspective grids and surreal imagery into a nostalgic scene.

用复古窗口、空间网格与超现实图像形成怀旧场景。

This study uses pink, cyan and violet while retaining a distinct foreground text layer.

本例采用粉、青、紫的色调关系，保留明确的前景文字层。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --pink: #FF69B4;
  --cyan: #00CED1;
  --purple: #9400D3;
  --gold: #FFD700;
  --blue: #1E90FF;
  --deep: #17022e;
  --deep-2: #2a0a4e;
  --win-bg: #ece6f7;
  --win-ink: #2a1246;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Vaporwave. Combine retro windows, perspective grids and surreal imagery into a nostalgic scene. This study uses pink, cyan and violet while retaining a distinct foreground text layer. Avoid losing text in fluorescent backgrounds or packing every retro motif into one screen. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

蒸汽波。用复古窗口、空间网格与超现实图像形成怀旧场景。本例采用粉、青、紫的色调关系，保留明确的前景文字层。避免荧光背景吞掉文字，不要把所有复古元素都塞进同一屏。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Retro windows and perspective grids can structure a scene
  - 中文：复古窗口与透视网格可构成场景结构
- Pink, cyan and violet can form a shared tonal relationship
  - 中文：粉、青、紫可形成统一色调关系
- Surreal imagery can support a defined narrative theme
  - 中文：超现实图像可以承接明确的叙事主题
- Foreground text can be separated from the decorative scene
  - 中文：前景文字层可以与装饰场景分离

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- The cultural context needs explanation beyond accumulated retro symbols
  - 中文：需要说明文化语境，避免只堆积复古符号
- Fluorescent colors and grids can interfere with body copy
  - 中文：荧光色与网格可能干扰正文阅读
- Overlapping windows need narrow-screen reading-order checks
  - 中文：窗口叠放需要检查窄屏阅读顺序
- Sculpture, music and old-interface assets need license checks
  - 中文：雕塑、音乐和旧界面素材需要核实授权

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Avoid losing text in fluorescent backgrounds or packing every retro motif into one screen.
  - 中文：避免荧光背景吞掉文字，不要把所有复古元素都塞进同一屏。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Macintosh Plus - Floral Shoppe · Saint Pepsi · Arizona Iced Tea x Adidas

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Vaporwave / 蒸汽波

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Combine retro windows, perspective grids and surreal imagery into a nostalgic scene.

用复古窗口、空间网格与超现实图像形成怀旧场景。

This study uses pink, cyan and violet while retaining a distinct foreground text layer.

本例采用粉、青、紫的色调关系，保留明确的前景文字层。

Avoid / 避免：Avoid losing text in fluorescent backgrounds or packing every retro motif into one screen. 避免荧光背景吞掉文字，不要把所有复古元素都塞进同一屏。

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. 以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。

- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

# Maximalism / 极繁主义

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Art · Distinctive / 艺术 · 个性
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：4 Expert; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：E-commerce / Retail / 电商 / 零售, Gaming / Entertainment / 游戏 / 娱乐
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/maximalism)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/maximalism.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/maximalism/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Establish a dominant visual, then enrich it with secondary type, patterns and layered content.

建立一个强主视觉，再用次级文字、图案与层叠内容丰富节奏。

High density, multiple scales and vivid colors coexist with hierarchy, repetition and echoes.

高密度、多尺度与鲜明色彩同时存在，仍有主次、重复和呼应。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --pink: #FF1493;
  --lime: #00FF00;
  --gold: #FFD700;
  --orange: #FF4500;
  --violet: #8B00FF;
  --violet-deep: #4B0082;
  --ink: #120019;
  --paper: #FFF3D6;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
  --serif: Georgia, serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Maximalism. Establish a dominant visual, then enrich it with secondary type, patterns and layered content. High density, multiple scales and vivid colors coexist with hierarchy, repetition and echoes. Disorder alone is not maximalism; reserve clear space for primary actions and body copy. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

极繁主义。建立一个强主视觉，再用次级文字、图案与层叠内容丰富节奏。高密度、多尺度与鲜明色彩同时存在，仍有主次、重复和呼应。不要把无序堆叠当作极繁；需要给主操作和正文留下明确位置。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Multiple type and image scales can form a rich hierarchy
  - 中文：多尺度文字与图像可形成丰富层级
- Repeating patterns can connect dense content
  - 中文：重复图案可以串联高密度内容
- Layering can support several narrative threads
  - 中文：叠放关系可支持多个叙事线索
- Vivid colors and quiet regions can arrange visual rhythm together
  - 中文：鲜明色彩与静区可共同安排视觉节奏

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- The dominant visual and primary action need explicit positions
  - 中文：需要明确主视觉与主操作的位置
- Image count and size need a separate budget and measurements
  - 中文：图片数量和尺寸需要独立预算与测量
- New content requires renewed occlusion and hierarchy checks
  - 中文：新增内容时需要重新检查遮挡与层级
- Mobile needs recomposition rather than a scaled desktop layout
  - 中文：手机端需要重排而非缩小整幅桌面构图

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Disorder alone is not maximalism; reserve clear space for primary actions and body copy.
  - 中文：不要把无序堆叠当作极繁；需要给主操作和正文留下明确位置。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

Gucci.com · Valentino · Dolce & Gabbana · Versace · Vogue Italia

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

# DESIGN.md — Maximalism / 极繁主义

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Establish a dominant visual, then enrich it with secondary type, patterns and layered content.

建立一个强主视觉，再用次级文字、图案与层叠内容丰富节奏。

High density, multiple scales and vivid colors coexist with hierarchy, repetition and echoes.

高密度、多尺度与鲜明色彩同时存在，仍有主次、重复和呼应。

Avoid / 避免：Disorder alone is not maximalism; reserve clear space for primary actions and body copy. 不要把无序堆叠当作极繁；需要给主操作和正文留下明确位置。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --pink: #FF1493;
  --lime: #00FF00;
  --gold: #FFD700;
  --orange: #FF4500;
  --violet: #8B00FF;
  --violet-deep: #4B0082;
  --ink: #120019;
  --paper: #FFF3D6;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
  --serif: Georgia, serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

# Kinetic Typography / 动态字体

- Type / 类型：Motion approach / 动态表现
- Tags / 标签：Art · Avant-garde / 艺术 · 前卫
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：3 Hard; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：Creative / Design / 创意 / 设计
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/kinetic)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/kinetic.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/kinetic/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Use moving type for rhythm and storytelling while preserving a complete static reading structure.

让文字运动承担节奏与叙事，静止时仍保留完整阅读结构。

Choreograph speed, displacement, spacing and weight; provide pause and respect reduced motion.

速度、位移、字距与字重有明确编排，提供暂停并尊重减弱动态效果。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #000000;
  --fg: #FFFFFF;
  --accent: #FF0000;
  --gray: #8a8a8a;
  --line: #2b2b2b;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Kinetic Typography. Use moving type for rhythm and storytelling while preserving a complete static reading structure. Choreograph speed, displacement, spacing and weight; provide pause and respect reduced motion. Do not replace content with endless marquees or trap important copy inside unpausable motion. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

动态字体。让文字运动承担节奏与叙事，静止时仍保留完整阅读结构。速度、位移、字距与字重有明确编排，提供暂停并尊重减弱动态效果。避免持续跑马灯代替内容；不要把关键文案放在无法停下的动画里。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Type motion can carry the rhythm of the content
  - 中文：文字运动可以承担内容节奏
- Displacement, weight and spacing can follow narrative stages
  - 中文：位移、字重和字距可对应叙事阶段
- A static composition can retain the same information hierarchy
  - 中文：静态构图可保留相同的信息层级
- Local motion can work with existing brand type
  - 中文：局部动效能与既有品牌字体配合

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Motion needs rendering and input-response checks on target devices
  - 中文：动画需要检查目标设备上的渲染和输入响应
- Readable static content and reduced-motion preferences must be supported
  - 中文：必须提供可读静态内容并尊重减弱动态效果
- Continuous motion needs pause controls and must not obscure the primary action
  - 中文：持续运动需要暂停控制，不能淹没主操作
- Essential copy should remain in the semantic document and be searchable
  - 中文：关键文字应存在于语义化文档中并可被检索

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Do not replace content with endless marquees or trap important copy inside unpausable motion.
  - 中文：避免持续跑马灯代替内容；不要把关键文案放在无法停下的动画里。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Apple keynotes · Active Theory works · Awwwards winners · KIKK Festival

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

Reference file: kinetic.html (260 source lines). Source and outputs can change together; retain the version and hash when recording an implementation decision.

# DESIGN.md — Kinetic Typography / 动态字体

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Use moving type for rhythm and storytelling while preserving a complete static reading structure.

让文字运动承担节奏与叙事，静止时仍保留完整阅读结构。

Choreograph speed, displacement, spacing and weight; provide pause and respect reduced motion.

速度、位移、字距与字重有明确编排，提供暂停并尊重减弱动态效果。

Avoid / 避免：Do not replace content with endless marquees or trap important copy inside unpausable motion. 避免持续跑马灯代替内容；不要把关键文案放在无法停下的动画里。

## Example token baseline / 示例 Tokens 基线

These values come from the exact reference source identified above. They are examples, not mandatory brand values. Before reuse, map them to existing project variables and document retained colors, fonts and spacing. Keep original example values when the user explicitly requests that demo's reproduction.

以下值来自上方 SHA-256 对应的演示源码，是示例而非强制品牌值。复用前映射到项目已有变量并记录保留的颜色、字体与间距。明确复现演示时保留示例原值。

```css
:root {
  --bg: #000000;
  --fg: #FFFFFF;
  --accent: #FF0000;
  --gray: #8a8a8a;
  --line: #2b2b2b;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}
```

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。
- Derive state styles from the same resolved project tokens. Keep selected, focus, disabled, validation, loading, empty and error states explicit; decoration never replaces labels or messages. / 组件状态使用同一套项目 Tokens，选中、焦点、禁用、校验、加载、空与错误需要明确表达。
- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Page rollout and maintenance / 页面迁移与维护

Implement and inspect one representative page before extending the same resolved rules to other authorized pages. Save before/after browser evidence, the final token mapping and component exceptions in the project's records. Update this document when a new page introduces a justified rule; do not silently create a second visual system.

先改造并验收一个代表页面，再扩展到其他已授权页面。记录浏览器前后对照、最终 Tokens 映射及组件例外；新页面确需新规则时同步更新本文件。

Machine-readable style brief: https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/kinetic.md
Reference HTML: https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/kinetic.html

# Anti-Design / 反设计

- Type / 类型：Visual aesthetic / 视觉美学
- Tags / 标签：Avant-garde · Distinctive / 前卫 · 个性
- Implementation estimate / 实现难度：2 Medium; an example complexity estimate, not a delivery-time promise.
- Candidate project types / 候选场景：E-commerce / Retail / 电商 / 零售
- [Original style page / 原始风格页](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/style/anti-design)
- [Reference HTML / 演示源码](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/demos/anti-design.html)
- [Ongoing DESIGN.md / 长期项目规范](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/anti-design/DESIGN.md)

## Principles / 风格原则

Break selected alignment and typographic conventions while keeping navigation and content order understandable.

有意打破局部对齐和字体惯例，同时让导航与内容顺序可理解。

Clashing primaries, displaced labels and mixed type create controlled tension in this study.

本例用冲突原色、错位标签和字体混搭，形成有控制的反差。

## Study boundaries / 演示边界

An original authored web study. Its palette, assets and dimensions are example choices, not a universal definition or an official brand template.

原创网页演绎。配色、素材和尺寸是当前示例的具体选择，不代表统一风格定义或品牌官方模板。

The study version identifies the existing reference family. The SHA-256 identifies the exact HTML bytes used for the tokens below; the delivery schema versions the document format. They do not certify a future AI-generated result.

风格版本标识参考系列，SHA-256 标识下列 Tokens 对应的 HTML 源码，交付结构版本标识文档格式；均不代表对后续 AI 生成结果的认证。

No claim of certified historical reproduction. / 不声称历史作品的认证复刻。

## Example values / 示例取值

Parsed from the first :root block of the reference HTML, ignoring CSS comments. These are the same values exposed by the website. Match them when reproducing this particular demo; for a project adaptation, preserve the existing brand and record deliberate mappings in DESIGN.md.

从演示源码首个 :root 变量块提取并忽略 CSS 注释，与网页的 Tokens 共用解析器。复现此演示时使用原值；项目改造时优先保留品牌，并在 DESIGN.md 记录映射。

```css
:root {
  --green: #89FC00;
  --magenta: #FF00FF;
  --red: #FF0000;
  --blue: #0000FF;
  --yellow: #FFFF00;
  --ink: #000000;
  --paper: #FFFFFF;
  --sans: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --serif: Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
```

## Bilingual style brief / 双语风格说明

Read the project brief and existing DESIGN.md first. Default to adapting the current project; this style description does not replace project constraints, routes, components or business content.

先读取项目简报和已有 DESIGN.md，默认改造当前项目；以下风格说明不能覆盖项目约束、路由、组件与业务内容。

**English**

Anti-Design. Break selected alignment and typographic conventions while keeping navigation and content order understandable. Clashing primaries, displaced labels and mixed type create controlled tension in this study. Occlusion, unusable controls and illegibility are not design goals. Adapt palette and dimensions to the content; use the current demo reference brief for an exact reproduction.

**中文**

反设计。有意打破局部对齐和字体惯例，同时让导航与内容顺序可理解。本例用冲突原色、错位标签和字体混搭，形成有控制的反差。不要把遮挡、不可点击或不可读当成设计目标。配色与尺寸可根据内容调整；精确复现请使用当前演示的参考包。

## Observable strengths / 设计取舍的优势

- Local displacement can create tension against a stable reading structure
  - 中文：局部错位可以与稳定的阅读结构形成反差
- Mixed type can support a defined expressive theme
  - 中文：字体混搭可承接明确的表达主题
- Clashing colors and labels can establish a distinct graphic vocabulary
  - 中文：冲突色与标签可建立独立图形语汇
- Experimental treatment can be limited to local content regions
  - 中文：实验区域可以限制在局部内容中

## Adaptation costs / 适配成本

- Navigation, focus and targets still need to be clear and usable
  - 中文：导航、焦点和点击目标仍需清楚可用
- Broken conventions need an expressive purpose recorded in the specification
  - 中文：打破的规则应有表达目的并写入规范
- Long Chinese headlines and font fallbacks can change displacement relationships
  - 中文：中文长标题与字体回退可能改变错位关系
- Multi-page expansion needs boundaries for which rules may vary
  - 中文：多页面扩展需要界定哪些规则可以变化

## Pitfalls / 避坑

- Occlusion, unusable controls and illegibility are not design goals.
  - 中文：不要把遮挡、不可点击或不可读当成设计目标。

## Project acceptance / 项目验收

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。
- Inspect default, hover, focus-visible, active, selected and disabled states where applicable. Verify keyboard navigation and visible focus, including dialogs and menus. / 检查适用的默认、悬浮、键盘焦点、按下、选中和禁用状态，以及弹窗与菜单的键盘操作。
- Check validation, loading, empty, error and long-content states in forms and data views. Keep labels and existing recovery actions available. / 检查校验、加载、空数据、错误与长内容状态，保留标签和已有恢复操作。
- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。

## Inspiration names / 灵感检索名称

Charli XCX - Brat · Balenciaga campaigns · MSCHF · Yaeji

These names are research leads rather than evidence that every page from those organizations matches this example. Verify the actual page and date before making a comparison. / 这些名称用于继续检索，不代表相关组织的每个页面都采用本例风格；对比前应核实具体页面与时间。

Reference file: anti-design.html (341 source lines). Source and outputs can change together; retain the version and hash when recording an implementation decision.

# DESIGN.md — Anti-Design / 反设计

This is a project design baseline derived from one style study. Merge it into an existing DESIGN.md; do not overwrite established project rules. Before implementation, record the actual project brief, authorized routes, protected behavior, brand/token mappings and exceptions in the project's copy. This downloaded baseline does not claim those project-specific decisions have already been made.

这是一份长期项目规范起点。已有 DESIGN.md 时合并相关规则，保留项目既定约定。实施前在项目副本记录实际简报、授权页面、业务保留项、品牌/Tokens 映射和例外；本下载文件不声称这些项目决定已完成。

## Decision order / 决策顺序

1. Apply the user's confirmed brief and authorized scope. Preserve the existing business behavior, brand and useful components unless explicitly changed. / 先遵循已确认的项目简报与授权范围，保留业务、品牌及可复用组件。
2. Keep these style principles while adapting the example choices to the project. / 保留风格原则，按项目调整示例取值。
3. Record a reason for exceptions and use the same resolved rules on later pages. / 为例外记录原因，后续页面沿用已经确定的规则。

## Style principles / 风格原则

Break selected alignment and typographic conventions while keeping navigation and content order understandable.

有意打破局部对齐和字体惯例，同时让导航与内容顺序可理解。

本例用冲突原色、错位标签和字体混搭，形成有控制的反差。

Avoid / 避免：Occlusion, unusable controls and illegibility are not design goals. 不要把遮挡、不可点击或不可读当成设计目标。

## Reusable components / 组件规则

- Reuse the current framework, component contracts and semantic elements. Style the existing navigation, buttons, inputs, tables, dialogs and feedback components that occur in the authorized scope. / 复用既有框架、组件契约与语义元素，覆盖授权范围中实际存在的导航、按钮、输入、表格、弹窗与反馈。

- Keep working API calls, forms, route behavior, data fields, copy and analytics. Demo brands, numbers, images and claims do not become project content. / 保留接口、表单、路由、字段、文案与统计，演示品牌、数字、图片和主张不带入业务内容。

## Responsive and fallback rules / 响应式与回退

These are requirements for the adapted project, not certified coverage of every demo. / 以下是改造项目的验收要求，不代表每个演示已覆盖全部状态。

- Preserve business logic, routes, API contracts, data fields, authentication, forms, copy, analytics and existing component behavior. Retain brand rules and assets unless the project brief explicitly changes them. / 保留业务逻辑、路由、接口、字段、鉴权、表单、文案、统计及组件行为；品牌规则和素材按项目简报保留。

- Test long Chinese headings, mixed Chinese/English labels, font fallback, enlarged text and unbroken URLs. Reorder content intentionally on narrow screens; avoid document-level horizontal scroll, clipping and occlusion. / 测试长中文标题、中英混排、字体回退、放大文字和连续 URL，检查窄屏重排、整页横向溢出、裁切与遮挡。
- Inspect the actual routes in a browser after assets load at project breakpoints; if unspecified, compare 390×844, 768×1024, 1280×800 and 1440×900, plus a 375px narrow-screen check. Record what was actually inspected. / 在实际浏览器中检查项目断点；未指定时用上述视口并记录真实检查范围。
- Honor prefers-reduced-motion with readable static content; provide pause for persistent movement. Supply a solid-surface fallback for unsupported material effects and check text/control contrast against changing backgrounds. / 减弱动态效果时保留静态内容，持续运动提供暂停，不支持材质效果时采用实色回退并检查对比。
- Verify existing task behavior and project checks after visual changes. Record intentional token adaptations, remaining limits and unperformed checks; do not claim output fidelity, loading speed or conversion from style alone. / 改造后验证原任务与项目检查，记录参数调整、限制和未验收项，不以风格本身承诺还原度、加载速度或转化结果。
